messages.content: Write one complete compact paragraph of at most 62 words from these two official blocks. Use the exact draft symbol with its sponsor, meeting date, adopted resolution, and three vote counts with the abstainers. Next state mandate expiry and that UNIFIL acts without prior permission within its mandate and continues coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement. Omit meeting ID, optional votes and commentary.

{"vote": "On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour.", "operative": "Operative paragraph 1 extended UNIFIL's existing mandate until 31 August 2024. Paragraph 15 reaffirmed its independence in carrying out mandated tasks without prior permission and its continued coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement."}

response.text: On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council adopted resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour, none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour. The mandate expires 31 August 2024; UNIFIL acts without prior permission within its mandate and continues coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement.
